### Salesforce
- [salesforce-skills](https://github.com/Clientell-Ai/salesforce-skills) - 10 skills covering the full Salesforce development lifecycle. `npx skills add Clientell-Ai/salesforce-skills`

  - `sf-flow` — Flow XML generation, Process Builder migration
  - `sf-lwc` — Lightning Web Components with LDS, navigation, LMS

  - `sf-security` — AppExchange security audit (CRUD/FLS, injection, sharing)
  - `sf-deploy` — Scratch orgs, packages, CI/CD, destructive changes
  - `sf-data` — Bulk API 2.0, external ID upsert, relationship ordering
  - `sf-schema` — All field types, formulas, rollup summaries, Global Value Sets
  - `sf-find` — Skill discovery and routing
